The route-map `FROM-R3` has no `match` clause, so it sets local-pref 200 on **every** route from r3 — including 192.168.2.0/24 (which r3 relays with AS path "65003 65002"). This causes r1 to pick the longer path through r3 for 192.168.2.0/24, violating the check "r1's best BGP path to 192.168.2.0/24 has AS path 65002, next hop 10.0.12.2".
